One-Pot Coconut Lentil Curry

Serves 6
  • 1 ½ cups red lentils, rinsed
  • 1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
  • 1 yellow onion, diced
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 2 tbsp curry powder
  • 4 cups vegetable stock
  • 1 bunch cilantro

Sweat the onion and garlic in a big pot until soft, about 5 minutes.

Stir in the curry powder for 30 seconds, then add lentils, coconut milk, and stock.

Simmer 25 minutes until the lentils collapse; season well.

Finish with cilantro and serve over rice.
